text: [voice note] Morning. Quick one, what does my day look like, and is it going to rain? I'm trying to decide between the local train and a cab.

Monday 4 May:
- 10:00 critical bugs count to #eng-weekly, then last week's signups by source
- 11:30 call with Kavya (campaign wrap-up, clinic list)
- 15:00 scope doc review with Arjun
- 16:30 release timing with Priya (moved from 14:00, now 30 min)
- Mumbai: 32 C, humid, showers likely after 17:00, so train in and a cab home if you stay late
Sources: your calendar, Linear, weather feed.
Train then. And remind me at 1pm to order lunch and call the barber.
Two reminders set for 13:00: order lunch, call the barber.
can you see traffic to the station
No live traffic here. I can tell you the 09:12 and 09:30 trains are the ones you took on the last two Mondays, if that helps.
[voice note] I'm on the train. Remind me where we are with Acme before I get in, I think Maya Rao had two questions I never answered.

Acme status:
- Proposal v1 went to Maya Rao on April 25, delivery target May 29, Arjun copied
- Her April 28 reply asks two things: is the reporting module in phase 2, and who owns data migration
- You have not replied to that yet, and nothing newer has come from Acme

Right. Reporting is phase 2 and migration is on us. I'll confirm in writing tomorrow, once Arjun has put it in the scope doc.
Noted for the reply: reporting in phase 2, migration owned by Kestrel. I will draft it once Arjun's scope doc is ready.
Anything urgent in the inbox before the 10:00 post?
Nothing that needs you before 10:00. No new mail from Acme, Imran, Maya Iyer or Brightline since Friday evening.
Pull critical bugs from Linear, count by team, post to #eng-weekly.
Posted to #eng-weekly: open critical bugs: Platform 6, Growth 3, Mobile 5 (14 total).
Which Platform ones are the oldest?

From the Linear pull: the oldest Platform critical is a large-export timeout, opened 16 days ago; Wednesday's fix handled the first customer's case but it still reproduces on larger projects. Next is a billing webhook retry bug at 12 days, with no assignee. Mobile's oldest is 9 days old and Growth's is 6.
Draft a note to Arjun about the webhook one. Ask who owns it, and say I need the migration paragraph for the Acme scope doc by tomorrow 10:30.

Draft to Arjun:\n"Arjun, two things. 1) The billing webhook retry bug in Platform is 12 days old and has no assignee in Linear. Who has it this week? 2) I need the data migration paragraph for the Acme scope doc by tomorrow 10:30, so I can answer Maya Rao's two questions. R."\nSend as is?
Make it 10:00 tomorrow, I want to reply to Maya before 11. Send.
Changed the deadline to 10:00 tomorrow and sent it to Arjun.
How did signups go last week? Break down by source.
Last week: 835 signups. Organic 281, Referral 205, LinkedIn 226, Direct 123.
Direct is up fifteen. Is that anything or noise?

Direct went from 108 to 123, about 14 percent, but it is still the smallest source at roughly 15 percent of the total. The total is up 34 (801 to 835, about 4 percent), with Organic +11, LinkedIn +10 and Referral -2. One week's move, so I would call it noise unless it repeats next week.
Arjun replied: the webhook bug is his, he starts today. Migration paragraph will be in the scope doc by 10:00 tomorrow.
What's the state of the clinic outreach list Kavya started?
Kavya's Growth board shows "Clinic outreach list v1", 22 clinics, status In progress. There are no notes on which clinics were already contacted, and no column for whether a clinic has a website.
A few of those I already pitched myself last month. I'll sort out which ones on Wednesday. Don't contact anyone until then.
Understood. No clinic outreach goes out until you give me the exclusions on Wednesday. I will ask you for them then.
Kavya call in 6 minutes. Topics you flagged: spring webinar wrap-up and the clinic list.
Draft a short agenda for Thursday's second conversation with Isha, the design candidate (her first round was April 28). 45 minutes, Priya will be in it.

1. Intros and role overview (5 min)
2. Portfolio walk-through by Isha (15 min)
3. How she works with developers (10 min)
4. Team and product context from you and Priya (5 min)
5. Her questions (10 min)
Anything you want changed?
Portfolio should get 20 minutes and the developers part only 5. Put the slot in my calendar too.

Revised: intros 5, portfolio 20, working with developers 5, team context 5, her questions 10. That totals 45. I have held Thursday 14:30 to 15:15 with a note that Priya joins by phone. I do not have Isha's email, so no invite has gone to her.
I'll message her myself.
Fine, I will leave the invite to you.

Reminder: call the barber.

joke

forget it, it was last week's

weather for the way home
Showers from about 17:00, heaviest 18:00 to 20:00. Cab is safer than the train if you leave after 17:30.

Thank you for the questions on scope. Reporting sits in phase 2, and data migration is ours to handle. Both are written into the attached scope doc. I would be glad to walk you and the team through it whenever suits you this week.

Best, R."

"Hi Maya,

Reporting is in phase 2. Migration is ours. I have put both in the scope doc, attached.

Best, R."

Held. Say send when you are ready.
who's in the office today

days till neel's wedding

- Thursday June 25 to Friday June 26

Both are held as tentative: June 18-19 and June 25-26, ending 15:30 on the Friday. Say if you want a venue shortlist next.
Tea break.
